skill_unavailable: This skill is unavailable or the execution environment changed. Remove it and select it again. Nothing was sent.
readonly_unsupported: Cannot apply read-only mode on this launch path. Choose a compatible terminal launcher without conflicting permission options.
timeout: The request timed out. The computer may be busy or the network unstable. Check whether it went through, then try again later.
unreachable: The connection to this computer dropped. Reconnect it, check whether your last action went through, then try again.
failed: The request could not be completed. Open details for the diagnostic.
input_draft: There is a draft in the terminal. Resolve it before sending.
dialog_open: The terminal is waiting for a choice. Resolve it there first.
prompt_changed: The terminal prompt has changed. Refresh before answering.
attach_busy: This session is busy in another client. Wait until it is available.
terminal_not_ready: The computer’s terminal wasn’t ready to start the agent. Nothing was sent; try again.
node_outdated: The computer’s Persona service is too old for this operation. Update it first.
in_doubt: Delivery cannot be confirmed. Check the result before sending again.
offline: This computer is offline. Make sure it’s on and connected to the internet and that Persona Link is running, then try again.
nothing_queued: Nothing is queued for the agent any more.
send_now_unsupported: This agent can’t send queued messages now. They go to it in order.
send_now_unrecognized: Persona doesn’t recognize this Claude Code’s send-now hint, so it pressed nothing. The queued messages still go in order; to send them now, use send-now in the terminal.
not_a_repository: This folder isn’t in a Git repository.
not_our_worktree: This folder isn’t a worktree Persona made.
worktree_in_use: An agent still runs in this worktree. Close it first.
worktree_unmerged: The branch has commits that aren’t on the main branch.
no_directory: Persona doesn’t know this pane’s folder.
detached_head: HEAD is detached. Switch to a branch first.
no_upstream: This branch has no upstream branch. Set one on the computer first.
uncommitted_changes: The working tree has uncommitted changes. Commit or stash them on the computer, then pull.
not_fast_forward: The branch and its upstream have both moved on, so it can’t fast-forward. Merge or rebase it on the computer.
push_rejected: The remote has newer commits. Pull first, then push. Nothing was forced.
peer_unsupported: This Claude session doesn’t offer a channel Persona can use for messages (an older Claude Code, or cross-session messages are turned off there). Continue it on the computer.
peer_unreachable: Couldn’t reach this Claude session’s message channel (it may have just restarted or quit). Try again shortly, or continue it on the computer.
peer_too_long: The message is too long for the message channel. Split it into shorter messages.
peer_unconfirmed: The message was handed to this Claude session, but it hasn’t taken it yet: it may be waiting for approval on the computer, or it was dropped as a repeat. Check on the computer before sending it again.
peer_command: The message channel only delivers plain messages and doesn’t run slash commands. Type the command on the computer.
desktop_open_failed: Claude’s desktop app on the computer didn’t open this session in time (it may still be starting, or the computer may be locked). Open it there, then send again. Nothing was sent.
modes_on_computer: This Claude session runs in Claude on the computer (its desktop app or another terminal). Change its mode, effort or model there.
modes_not_running: This agent isn’t running. Resume it from its terminal page, then change this.
agent_stopped: This agent has stopped. Its conversation and terminal stay; it doesn’t take messages, and nothing was sent. To run it again, use Resume on its terminal page.
shell_waiting: The new terminal tab stopped on a question before the agent could start. Nothing ran; the tab stays open for a few minutes so it can be answered.
start_line_rejected: The new terminal tab didn't take the start command, twice. Nothing ran; check what that shell does when it starts, then try again.
directory_untypable: This directory’s name contains a control character, such as a tab or a line break, so the agent can’t be started in it from here. Rename the directory or choose another one.
codex_not_ready: Codex on the computer isn’t at its input box yet (still loading, or another screen is open). Nothing was sent; try again in a moment.
codex_first_text: Codex’s first message can only be text. Remove the photos or files, then send it again.
codex_first_unconfirmed: The message went into Codex, but its session didn’t appear in time. Check the computer before sending it again.
codex_waiting: Codex hasn’t had its first message yet. This works once it has its session.
codex_no_box: Codex opened in a new tab on the computer, but its input box didn’t appear within a minute.
codex_no_box_here: Codex started in the pane you picked, but its input box didn’t appear within a minute. The pane is left as it is.
switch_unsupported: Only a Claude Code agent running in a terminal, on a model provider Persona can tell, can switch to another model provider. Start a new conversation to use that one.
switch_launcher_missing: That model provider isn’t set up on this computer. Pick another one.
switch_other_agent: That model provider runs another agent, not Claude Code. Start a new conversation to use it.
switch_model_locked: That model provider always runs its own model, so the one you picked wouldn’t be used. Pick it without a model, or pick another provider.
switch_config_dir: That model provider keeps Claude Code’s data and sign-in in another folder, where this conversation isn’t saved. Start a new conversation to use it.
switch_not_stopped: The agent didn’t quit, so it stays on its current model provider and the switch was dropped. Nothing was sent.
switch_failed: The agent couldn’t start on the other model provider, so it went back to the one it was on and the switch was dropped. Your message wasn’t sent.
switch_failed_stopped: The agent couldn’t start on the other model provider and has stopped; the switch was dropped. Your message wasn’t sent. Check its terminal, or use Resume on its terminal page.
switch_stale: The agent moved to another model provider since you picked this one. Look at the provider it runs on now, then pick again.
switch_pick_model: Persona can’t see which model that model provider runs by default, and without one the conversation would keep its current model. Pick a model of that provider.
switch_under_way: The agent is moving to another model provider right now. Try again once it runs; nothing was done.
switch_busy: The agent is busy right now (working, waiting for you, starting, or running something in the background), so it wasn’t moved to the other model provider. Nothing was sent; try again once it has stopped.
rewind_busy: Wait for the session to become idle before rewinding.
rewind_unsupported: This session does not support the requested rewind.
rewind_mismatch: The selected message moved. Reload the conversation before rewinding.
rewind_nothing: There is no message to rewind to.
rewind_failed: Rewind could not be confirmed. Reload the conversation to check its current history.
preview_no_terminal: This computer has no terminal engine to run the server in. Turn one on in this computer’s settings, then try again.
space_gone: No engine on this computer lists this space any more. Refresh and try again.
assistant_service_tier_start_only: Fast can be chosen only when starting a new conversation. Change it in the existing conversation instead.
assistant_service_tier_unsupported: Fast from the first message is available only for Codex models that offer it. Nothing was sent.
assistant_service_tier_refused: Codex couldn’t apply Fast before the first message. Nothing was sent; try again or choose Standard.
